name: Cosmecca Korea
verdict: HOLD-SMALL / RP_FAIR — EDGE DEAD (court). Own as a quality-ODM ramp at fair forward, NO catalyst edge. Tranched entry (fills on weakness, no chase). NOT the dislocation-beat trade originally staged.
entry_band: RESIZED 2026-07-21 (deployable-book denominator): ladder T1 instr#117 100@71,000 / T2 instr#118 115@64,000 GTC (~$9.7k = ~1% of $1mm deployable; replaces the undersized 25/30-sh live orders — user cancels 1403896620/1403896622). Fills on weakness only; adds/re-underwrite ONLY post-print (~Aug-13).
kill_triggers: a DATED US/Korea cosmetics-specific tariff appears (the Jul-31 Sec-232 was pharma, not cosmetics) -> re-rate the beat-lean down
China subsidiary raw-material supply issue (Jul-8 note) escalates into a guidance cut
Q2 (~Aug-13) misses the beat-lean (Samsung Q2e +26% rev / +14% OP) -> exit, thesis falsified
block sale / insider selling / customer-concentration loss disclosed

court_record.dd: 6.5/10 - real business, fragile edge. Fwd P/E 11-12x, EV/EBITDA 7.2x(26E), OP margin ~13% expanding, top-5 customers <35%, Englewood US arm profitable ~17%. But UNDISCOVERED REFUTED (10-11 analysts Strong Buy); -12.6% wk = AI/semi KOSDAQ beta (-5.33% 07-20) not idiosyncratic; Samsung calls its own +26%/+14% Q2e 'in line'; price NOT near a floor (June 62.9k -17% below).
court_record.red_fable: 8/10 CANCEL. Dislocation = decaying Jul-8 note-pump (spiked 88.7k, round-tripped); no beat (can't beat consensus by printing it); in-line into Strong-Buy = sell event -> 64-68k; OP-miss live (decel + China raw-mat + won); asymmetry inverted (-17/-30% vs +8-10%, carry-less); 'fair forward' a trap on a rolling slope. Entry = 63-65k post-print.
court_record.blue_fable: 5/10 HOLD-small. CONCEDED all 3 edge legs dead (UNDISCOVERED, beat-edge, dislocation). Rebutted: CANCEL conflates 'no edge' with 'not ownable' (RP_FAIR: 6.5/10 biz, 11-12x fwd, bounded tails, sleeve-capped IS ownable with zero edge); 63-65k is timing masquerading as discipline (missed-entry ledger says these gates fail more than save); PEG <0.5 on 26% growth is not a trap multiple. Verdict HOLD small, no add pre-print.
court_record.presiding_adjudication: EDGE is DEAD (both benches agree; red earned its kills). What survives is only RP_FAIR ownership. Response taxonomy: a TIMING finding gates to TRANCHE, not chase (red) and not cancel-entirely (blue overreach the other way is 'hold at 76k'). RULING: cancel the 76k chase - there is no edge/urgency to justify paying the whipsaw midpoint in a risk-off tape - and re-stage a ladder that fills on weakness (T1 71k shallow dip honors blue's missed-entry point; T2 64k honors red's not-near-a-floor point). Own it SMALL and FAIR, adds gated on the post-print re-underwrite. The beat-lean is re-expressed as a two-call: operating 0.58 (frozen, likely) + reaction COSMECCA-STK 0.44 (in-line into crowding = sell-lean).

edge_explainer.market_believes: K-beauty small-caps are high-beta China/tariff exporters - sell them in a risk-off Korean tape.
edge_explainer.we_believe: The business is a genuine quality ODM at a fair 11-12x forward with expanding margins - but the DISLOCATION/beat EDGE we first saw is not there: the drop is beta, the beat is consensus, the name is crowded. It's ownable fair, not cheap-with-an-edge.
edge_explainer.why_we_might_have_edge: We DON'T on this name - court confirmed. The only justification to own is RP_FAIR (fairly-paid quality, bounded tails, sleeve-capped), not an information or timing edge.
edge_explainer.why_it_might_be_priced_in: 11 analysts at Strong Buy, consensus already marks the deceleration; there is no surprise to capture into the print.
edge_explainer.what_resolves_it: The ~Aug-13 Q2 print sets the next entry; an in-line result likely sells off (COSMECCA-STK 0.44), which is where the ladder fills.
edge_explainer.mechanism_falsifier: A DATED cosmetics-tariff/customer-loss headline, or Q2 OP actually missing, flips this from RP_FAIR-hold to exit.
edge_explainer.edge_type: RP_FAIR quality-ODM, NO edge overlay, tranched entry, ~1% sleeve cap

catalyst_overlays.call: COSMECCA beat-lean 0.58 frozen; leading signals UP (H1 US exports +41.5%, Samsung Q2e +26% rev, full-capacity plant, Jul-8 target raise). Add tier gates here.
